summary: The SDK has a Quick Look panel data model (items, clamped index, step, toggle, close) and a thumbnail path cache, but the shell does not draw the floating panel and apps get no view, extension or data-based preview API. Files has its own in-app previews for text, image, audio, PDF, folder and info cards.

features.apple: QLPreviewPanel: shared(), dataSource, reloadData(), refreshCurrentPreviewItem(), currentController
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs (PreviewPanel: set_items, step, toggle, reload_data, make_key_and_order_front, close); springboard/proto/src/peek.rs (ToShell::Preview 0x1e0, PreviewClose 0x1e1)
features.note: The SDK sends the messages, but the shell has no consumer for ToShell::Preview, so nothing is drawn. No shared() singleton, no refreshCurrentPreviewItem(), no controller responder chain.
URL and title are carried (URL cut to 256 bytes, title to 96, at most 16 items). No display state.

Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No data source protocol or delegate callbacks. The app pushes a whole list with set_items; there is no lazy loading block and no transition source frame.

features.apple: QLPreviewView: init(frame:style:), previewItem, refreshPreviewItem(), displayState, autostarts, close
features.note: Wave 6 (b06, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. The preview is a Files-owned page, not an SDK view an app can place in its own view hierarchy.

features.feature: Built-in previews for common file types
features.apple: Quick Look generates previews for common file types (text, images, audio, video, PDF, documents)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/files/preview.rs (preview_for, line 28: text, image, audio card, video, PDF, folder summary, info card); springboard/src/files/mod.rs (spawn_preview: PDF text via the Books engine)
features.note: Only the Files app uses these. The SDK offers no built-in renderer, so other apps get nothing unless they render thumbnails themselves.

features.apple: QLThumbnailGenerator: request, update handlers, multiple representations
features.note: Caches PNG paths under the bifrost-quicklook cache directory. The caller renders each thumbnail. No update handlers, and a single result per request.

features.apple: Arrow keys and panel navigation through the data source; Space toggles the panel
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs (step, toggle, line 49 and 59); springboard/src/files/mod.rs (step_preview, line 438: previous or next file in the folder)
features.note: Files steps through its folder without wrapping. The SDK panel's step and toggle have no shell-side key handling yet.

Wave 3 (theme-22, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No mechanism for an app to register a preview for its own file types, and no searchable item preview.
Wave 6 (b06, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No out-of-process preview extension that returns data, PDF or HTML replies.

gaps: The shell does not draw the Quick Look panel: ToShell::Preview and PreviewClose are decoded and ignored (springboard/proto/src/lib.rs:677-679).
No app-facing preview extension point: no equivalent of QLPreviewingController or QLPreviewProvider.
No embeddable preview view (QLPreviewView) in the SDK.
The SDK has no built-in file renderers for QLThumbnailGenerator; each app renders its own thumbnails.
No thumbnail update handlers or multi-representation requests.
No panel data source or delegate protocol, no lazy loading block, and no display state for items.
The Files Quick Look menu item is not in springboard/apps/files/src/main.rs: the index returned a MENU_QUICK_LOOK constant there, but a grep of the current file finds none.
